The set is still growing.

description.text: The 2026 print of Celebratory Fanfare with Yuu Nishida's art, the end-of-season reward of the 2025-2026 season. Ace Trainers, players who earned 200 Championship Points in the card game, the video games or Pokémon GO, get a copy with "Ace Trainer" in gold foil and a Play! Pokémon logo, shipped by 31 January 2027, with Latin America now included through copies handed out at Regional and Special Championships; in Malaysia, the Philippines and Singapore copies have the "Pokémon Game On!" logo. In Japan the same art is 147/M-P. The date listed for this card, 31 January 2027, is that shipping deadline, as no source says when the first copies go out.

description.text:
A Pikachu given to finishers of Pokémon RUN 30, noncompetitive fun runs held in seven Asian regions from October 2026 to January 2027 for Pokémon's 30th anniversary. Runners pick a first partner, tackle Gym-themed obstacles and collect stickers along the course, and every verified finisher can collect one card. Pokémon revealed it on 2 September 2026: a 60 HP Lightning Pikachu in a red running cap racing through a tropical landscape, with a Pokémon RUN stamp over the art.

This English print went to finishers in the Philippines (3 and 4 October 2026, SM Mall of Asia), Singapore (7 and 8 November, The Kallang) and Malaysia (21 and 22 November, KLCC). Pokémon has said the card may also be given out at other events.

description.text: An oversize-only promo drawn by Naoyo Kimura for "Pokécology", the Pokémon × Natural History Museum pop-up in the museum's Cranbourne Boutique in London from 26 January to 19 April 2026. It was given, one per customer, with purchases at the pop-up, never sold or offered online, and from 30 January 2026 with purchases at some UK shops; it was not available from the Pokémon Center.
